career_ladder.note: Civil Police Officers (CPO) / Police Constables are recruited battalion-wise (Armed Police Battalions: SAP, KAP I, KAP II, KAP III, KAP IV, KAP V, MSP) and in District Armed Reserve / Local Police units under Kerala Police. Officers advance from Civil Police Officer to Senior Civil Police Officer (Head Constable), Assistant Sub-Inspector, Sub-Inspector, and Inspector of Police based on seniority, qualifying service, and departmental promotion tests.

exam_scheme.note: Selection to Civil Police Officer (Police Constable) involves four sequential stages: Written OMR Examination (Objective type carrying 100 marks), Physical Measurement Test (PMT), Physical Efficiency Test (PET - National Physical Efficiency 1-star standard), and Medical Examination. Ranked lists are prepared battalion-wise based strictly on marks obtained in the Written OMR Examination among candidates who qualify the physical and medical stages.

financial_package.note: Civil Police Officers in Kerala Police are paid under the Kerala State 11th Pay Revision (G.O.(P) No. 27/2021/Fin) in the pay scale of ₹31,100 - ₹66,800 with entry basic pay of ₹31,100.
financial_package.pay_source_label: Kerala PSC Gazette Notification Cat. No. 593/2023 & Kerala Police Headquarters Pay Rules
financial_package.estimate_note: Calculated on Kerala State 11th Pay Revision entry basic pay of ₹31,100 with standard 58% DA (effective 1 Jul 2025, ₹18,038) plus House Rent Allowance (Class A ₹3,110, Class B ₹2,100, Class C ₹1,500), Police Uniform Allowance (₹1,000/month), and Risk/Washing allowance; net in-hand reflects statutory deductions for National Pension System (NPS, 10% on Basic+DA = ₹4,914), MEDISEP health insurance (₹500/month), State Life Insurance (SLI), Police Welfare Fund, and Professional Tax.
official_perks: Government police barracks accommodation or designated police quarters in armed battalions and district camps
Annual uniform maintenance allowance and kit supply by Kerala Police Department
Comprehensive medical coverage under the Kerala Government MEDISEP scheme
Risk allowance and special duty compensatory allowances during VIP security, law & order, and festival duties
Subsidized police canteen facilities (Kerala Police Subsidized Canteen - KPSC/CAPF pattern)
Police Department Welfare and Benevolent Fund coverage for personnel and families
